hypotheses.justification: Apply heatPotential_kernel_integrable_on_split with center z := q, evaluation point q, and the same positive radius r. Its ball-membership assumption follows from Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le in the parabolic pseudometric. By heatPotential_near_far_cover, this split covers univ, so integrableOn_univ gives global integrability of every kernel-source product. Integrable.integrableOn then supplies hInt for the original split centered at z. The remaining proof is unchanged. This works for arbitrary q, including outside the original ball, and also for zero sources.
